Proposal: keep sessions in Redis. Reads are sub-millisecond and TTL expiry is free. Objections?
No objection. Writing ADR-004 so it is on record.
Redis is costing us about 40% more than planned and we lost sessions during the July failover. I propose moving sessions to Postgres.
Decision: sessions move from Redis to Postgres. Cost and durability. ADR-004 is superseded, migration starts Monday.
Staying on Jenkins for now, it already works for every repo.
Jenkins agents flaked 11 times this month. Decision: we migrate CI to GitHub Actions, Jenkins is retired by end of July.
v1 is the public API. Partners and the mobile app build against it.

Reconciliation will run nightly as a batch job. Simple and auditable.
Mobile stays on REST against the public API. No GraphQL for now.
Access tokens will expire after 15 minutes, refresh tokens handle the rest.

chunk_sources.ADR-004:
Context: we need a session store.

Decision: sessions are stored in Redis with a 24 hour TTL.

Consequences: Redis must be highly available.
chunk_sources.ADR-007:
Context: services need a durable event log.

Decision: the event bus runs on Kafka.

Consequences: operate a Kafka cluster and a schema registry.
chunk_sources.DOC-onboarding:
Welcome to Northwind engineering.

Sessions: user sessions are stored in Redis, so run a local Redis when testing auth flows.

Events: services publish domain events to Kafka. Install the Kafka CLI tools and point them at the dev cluster.

CI: pushes run on GitHub Actions.
chunk_sources.DOC-auth-readme:
auth-service issues and validates access tokens.

Sessions are stored in Redis. Configure SESSION_REDIS_URL.

Access tokens expire after 15 minutes.
chunk_sources.DOC-runbook-deploy:
To deploy, trigger the Jenkins pipeline named deploy-prod. CI runs on Jenkins.

Rollback: re-run the previous Jenkins build.
chunk_sources.DOC-event-bus-readme:
event-bus is the company event backbone.

The event bus runs on Kafka. Topics follow the domain.event.v1 naming scheme.

Consumers must commit offsets after processing.
chunk_sources.ADR-011:
Context: producers and consumers need shared schemas.

We adopt a schema registry. This follows the decision to use Kafka as the event bus.

Consequences: schema compatibility checks run in CI.
